# Designing and Reading Experiments

> Design a randomised experiment a public office can act on, size it, check it and read its result without fooling yourself. SDAIA Academy course DS-205, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 19,279 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Design](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/slides/day1.md): A question becomes a design: what to compare, what to measure, whom to randomise, written down before any data exist; sessions: Which claims need an experiment, Decision, hypothesis and metrics, Choosing the unit of randomisation, Pre-registration; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/slides/day1.html; about 6,134 tokens
- [Day 2: Size and run](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/slides/day2.md): How many units, for how long: the size a minimum effect demands, checked by simulation, and the calendar a test must cover; sessions: Power and the minimum effect, Power by simulation, Cluster randomisation, Run time and seasonality; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/slides/day2.html; about 5,374 tokens
- [Day 3: Read the result](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/slides/day3.md): The data are in: check the assignment, estimate with an interval, count the ways to fool yourself, review someone else's result; sessions: Did randomisation work, Estimate, interval and effect, False wins by simulation, Reviewing a reported result; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/slides/day3.html; about 6,049 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: the design and analysis pack and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/slides/capstone.md): Each participant defends one design choice of a pack on one of three synthetic cases in eight minutes, then answers four minutes of questions; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/slides/capstone.html; about 1,043 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Six studies, three designs](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D1_1_six_studies.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: The first half of the pre-registration](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D1_2_decision_metrics.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Three tests, three units](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D1_3_three_units.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Complete and review a pre-registration](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D1_4_pre_registration.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: Sample sizes for three minimum effects](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D2_1_sample_sizes.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: Power by simulation](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D2_2_power_simulation.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: 24 branches, 12 and 12](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D2_3_branch_clusters.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Choose the run time](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D2_4_run_time.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Ratio and balance on the export](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D3_1_ratio_balance.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Analyse the reminder test](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D3_2_reminder_result.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: A thousand A/A tests](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D3_3_false_wins.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Review a write-up](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-205/labs/D3_4_review_memo.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
